output_text: Lynn Davies, 58, from Neath, was given a deal by Cardiff Crown Court judge Patrick Curran QC in October and given six months to repay the cash he charged victims £500 on top of every £1,000 borrowed, loaning £23,395 over seven years, pocketing £33,425. He was caught after an anonymous tip-off to the Wales Illegal Money Leading Unit and has since repaid the profit he made, which was almost £10,000. Davies previously threatened his victims if they did not pay and has since repaid the money.
